description: Link a control to a custom risk (write — editor+), optionally with the document whose standard it is an exception against. Changing an accepted exception's links clears its approval.

document_id.description: Organisation document that sets the standard this risk is an exception against — obtain from scf_list_documents (404 if not this org's). A link with a document makes the custom risk a standards exception

risk_code.description: Custom risk code in R-ORG-N format (e.g., 'R-ORG-1') — obtain from scf_list_custom_risks

scf_id.description: SCF control ID to link (e.g., 'AST-01') — obtain from scf_list_scoped_controls

name: scf_add_custom_risk_control
